shots.content: Inside a kitchen, a rectangular island stands between a sink counter and a refrigerator, with a window along one side and an aisle along the opposite side. A woman in a blue shirt sits at the sink-side aisle stool and proposes a recipe for making stew, a man in a yellow shirt sits at the refrigerator-side aisle stool, a woman in a purple shirt sits at the sink-side window stool, and a woman in a red shirt sits at the refrigerator-side window stool.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the refrigerator end, looking along the kitchen island toward the sink counter, with both window-side stools and both aisle-side stools and the sink counter in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a blue shirt and a man in a yellow shirt exchange seats, as she explains a scraping technique for the ingredients and he questions the difficulty.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the window side, centered on the two adjacent aisle-side stools.

shots.content: A man in a yellow shirt refuses to follow the tedious recipe instructions.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the window side, centered on the person at the sink-side aisle stool.

shots.content: A woman in a blue shirt asks to proceed with the original stew plan.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the kitchen island.
